text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After school,
I decide to kill some time in
the trainer's office until my
training session with Nice Nature,
but as I open the door, I see a
familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heyo, Trainer. I was just about to knock.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of course, star students are always
punctual... Just kidding. A friend
of mine
lent me this manga, so I've been flipping
through it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The title's "Beyond the Turf"—you know it,
Trainer? It's all the rage
with the kids
lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look at the manga on the desk. On
the cover is an illustration
of an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Looks like you don't.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's no good—you gotta keep up with
what the youngsters are into
nowadays...
Not that I knew about it till today
either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's why my friend basically forced
it on
me, y'know. I can see why
it's so popular,
though—it really sucks you in.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It tells the story of an Umamusume aiming
to be loved by all as she
competes with
rivals and friends alike.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And get this—I just got to the part where
her dream of winning the
Triple Crown
gets shattered. Man, that was a real
nail-biter.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I keep running, my dream will
never die!" When she said
that, I got the
chills.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup, she's the kinda protagonist you
wanna root for. It's like,
she's got that
extra spark, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She's talented but also super hardworking
and sticks to her beliefs.
Pretty much the
perfect Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
I guess that's to be expected from
a fictional character.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But you know,
girls like her really do exist.
In fact, there's a few right
here at this
academy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
C-come on, don't try to pump me up like
that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I was in this manga, I'd be the side
character who's comforting the
crying
protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She even talks like I do. Like here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No matter how hard you try, there are hurdles you just can't overcome." That's so me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Makes me wanna go tell her, "Stop being a
wet blanket and suck it up." Haha, you
know that feeling of disliking someone too
similar to
you?

text_block_list.name: Nature's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, is Natie—ah, there you are. I
finished the latest volume of
"Beyond the
Turf," so I brought it over for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just telling Trainer about this
manga.
You know that side
character who's always
hanging around the main character?

text_block_list.name: Nature's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she really pops off in the newest
volume! Every one of her lines
really
resonated with me!

text_block_list.name: Nature's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not a prodigy... But I want to keep
trying, keep winning, and see
my happily
ever after!" Like, sooo amazing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, spoilers! For real, though? She said
all that? Huh? As a side
character?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-no no no no! You think I'd ever talk
about my "happily ever after"?

text_block_list.name: Nature's Friend
text_block_list.text:
You know, Natie, recently you seem more
serious, or like—I can feel
your passion
from the way you run.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Not you too?! No way, no way, no
way! Not a chance!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at the time—we gotta start
training! To the track we go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon! I told you already, I'd never say
something like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nature and I head for the track, where
another fruitful day of training
awaits.
